Item No.1: To confirm the minutes of the meeting dated 25th June, 2026 & 06th July

Item No.3:

Item No.5:
"Discussed.
The minutes of the meetings dated 25th June, 2026 & 06th July, 2026 are
confirmed and approved".
To discuss with the empanelled Chartered Accountants/Cost Accountants
of the Authority regarding the scrutiny and presentation of the proposal.
"Discussed.
After interaction with the empanelled Chartered Accountants/Cost Accountants
and considering the points deliberated during the meeting, it was decided that an
online fee proposal format be provided to the Chartered Accountants/Cost
Accountants for submission of their written comments and suggestions. The
matter, along with the inputs received from them, shall be placed before the
Authority in its next meeting for further consideration and a final decision".
To discuss with the software development team of MAHA IT about the
development of comprehensive new software for the Authority.
"Discussed.
The following were present;
1. Ms. Punam Mahajan, Project Manager, Maha-IT (M.S).
2. Mr. Dinesh Somwansh, Project Lead, Maha-IT (M.S).
The subject was deliberated in detail. It was resolved that the proposal shall be
prepared after an in-depth review of the present work and after due coordination
with the Member Secretary, F.R.A. The proposal shall thereafter be submitted for
approval".
To discuss the norms set by the Authority on salary and non-salary
Expenditure of the Unaided Private Professional Educational
Institutions/Colleges.
"Discussed.
After elaborate discussion, it was resolved to entrust the work to Shri. Nitin
Bapurao Chavan, Chartered Accountant and Member of the Fees Regulating
Authority, to study the matter in detail and submit his recommendations for further
consideration".
To discuss in the matter of Writ Petition No.1769/2026 filed by Loknete
Rajaram Bapu Patil Ayurvedic Medical College, Hospital, (BAMS0022).
"Discussed.
The matter was considered and approved, subject to submission of an
Affidavit duly authorised by Mr. B.T. Jagade, Under Secretary, F.R.A., incorporating
the points deliberated upon during the meeting, for approval at the level of the
Member Secretary, F.R.A".
